parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTestUtilities/Harness/AudioPlayerTestHarness.swift`. The two initializers are overloads of a test harness type (`AudioPlayerTestHarness`) that differ intentionally in their dependency surface — one accepts `mockHTTPClient` and `mockAudioEngine` in addition to the parameters shared by the other. This is the canonical pattern of a test fixture providing convenience initializers with varying mock configurations, not accidental duplication. Merging or abstracting them would couple test setup paths that are deliberately kept separate for different test scenarios.
